O seară de Diwali la Jodhpur: pornești la apus de sub turnul cu ceas, te strecori prin bazar printre tuk-tuk-uri, plonjezi în fântâna în trepte Toorji ka Jhalra, urci prin orașul albastru spre cetatea care crește în parbriz. Pornim din piața cu rangoli, trecem bazarul Sardar cu tuk-tuk-uri pe banda stângă, de împins, coborâm pe rampa fântânii în trepte — ac de păr la fund, la −9 m — și urcăm pe peretele opus, urcăm prin orașul albastru spre fort (sau prin ulicioara, dacă vaca nu s-a culcat în gura ei), trecem în zigzag prin cele trei porți cu țepi ale fortului Mehrangarh, ieșim pe bastionul-limbă — tot orașul albastru sub tine — coborâm pe stânca de riolit a parcului de deșert, sărim golful lacului Devkund cu cenotaful Jaswant Thada în dreapta, și revenim pe dreapta lungă spre turnul cu ceas. Sens orar pe plan, orașul albastru în interiorul buclei. Traseul de aici e cel din Track17.tscn, trecut prin ProbeLayout, ProbeBuried, ProbeRace și ProbeJodVaca. Relieful din captură e placeholder: orașul, fortul și lumina de Diwali vin din dioramă, apoi din assets. Ceasul de lumină nu e ciclic: cursa ține cât un apus, turul 1 auriu, turul 3 noapte cu artificii.

Ceasurile de hazard tur ~78 s

Reguli care au decis harta

Fortul e perete, nu siluetă. Creasta palatului e la +56, camera l-ar cuprinde întreg doar de la ~500 m, dincolo de ceață. Nu se ridică marginea camerei și nu se micșorează fortul: se citește de aproape, pe bastion, la 10–18 m de fațada Moti Mahal, unde primele două etaje de jharokha și jali sunt exact la înălțimea camerei.

Bastionul iese SPRE oraș, nu paralel cu stânca. Dacă drumul de pe metereze ar merge paralel cu marginea, orașul ar fi la 90° lateral — în afara cadrului. Bastionul-limbă iese spre interiorul buclei, pe brațul de ieșire orașul e în față, la 18–30° sub orizontală, în cadru.

Traficul e mașină, nu hazard cinematic. Tuk-tuk-urile sunt corpuri Car reale cu masă (0,45 din Buggy): principiul „bumping cu masă" iese din fizică, nu din reguli scrise pe cazuri. AI-ul le vede gratis prin lista traffic, fără cod nou de percepție.

Vaca nu oprește pe nimeni, doar închide o opțiune. Lecția semaforului Fiordland (patru runde picate cu oprire): vaca în gura ulicioarei = scurtătura închisă, nimeni nu e comutat pe ea cât ea o blochează, altfel mașinile se opresc reciproc în fața ei.

Gura ulicioarei se măsoară, nu se scrie ca distanță de la furcă. Prima construcție a pus vaca la 90 m înăuntru; a doua a pus-o pe șoseaua principală. Gura reală e primul punct unde banda a ieșit complet de pe asfaltul buclei (~30 m după furcă, banda tangentă stă ~25 m suprapusă).

Ceasul de lumină merge pe progres, nu pe timp. Altfel un tur lent ar fi mai întunecat decât unul rapid, iar recordurile de tur nu s-ar mai compara. Pe progres, același punct din cursă are aceeași lumină în orice rulare.

Lista de assets, cu verdictul trecerii de contracte —

Materiale: estimat ~24, plafon ≤ 30, gardă veto ≤ 38 (comparație: Fiordland 29, Serengeti 31, Chongqing 32). Trei piese noi de cod, toate mici: TrafficController + tuktuk.tres, CowGate (generalizare a branch_is_open, azi doar LavaFlowHazard) și DuskCycle (frate cu RainCycle). Orașul albastru e mii de case: peste ~40 m de drum devine MultiMesh feliat pe zone, doar primul rând e DecorManual cu coliziune.

1 · Planul de referință pentru ChatGPT · captura reală din Godot, adnotată docs/track_briefs/img/jodhpur_plan.png

Asta se atașează la prompturi, nu planul schematic de mai sus: bucla, ulicioara, fântâna, stânca fortului și lacul sunt geometria din Track17.tscn (ortografic, Snapshot.tscn -- --track=17 --no-fog --dusk=0), literele și dreptunghiurile sunt legenda. Orașul, fortul și lumina de Diwali nu apar în captură (decorul nu e construit) — de aceea sunt descrise în cuvinte, iar planul dă bucla, cotele și pozițiile hazardelor. Compasul planului e oglindit față de axele lumii, de aceea promptul spune doar stânga/dreapta.

2 · Prompt pentru dioramă (ChatGPT) · v0.2 

Create a stylized low-poly **tabletop diorama** of a toy-car racing track in
**the old blue city of Jodhpur, Rajasthan, India, on the evening of Diwali,
at sunset**.

**THE ATTACHED IMAGE IS THE REAL TRACK SEEN FROM ABOVE [!].** Follow its
road shape exactly: the loop, the stepwell hairpin, the zig-zag up the fort
rock and the alley shortcut. Its **bottom edge is the front** of the
diorama. Ignore the big orange blobs at its edges and the flat orange ground
colour: they are placeholders, not buildings or hills.

**THE ROAD IS ONE CLOSED LOOP. READ THIS FIRST [!]**
- There is **exactly one closed loop of road**, plus **one narrow alley
  shortcut** that leaves the loop and rejoins it on the same side. No other
  roads, no dead ends, no parking lots.
- The loop runs **clockwise** seen from above, exactly as in the attached
  image. It starts at the **front centre** (the clock tower square), runs
  **to the left** along the front (the bazaar), turns **up the left side**
  (the stepwell, then the blue city), crosses the **back** climbing toward
  the fort, which sits on a rock in the **back-right corner**, comes **down
  the right side** over bare pink rock (the lake and the white marble
  cenotaph are on the far right), and returns along a **long straight** from
  the right to the clock tower at the front.
- **The inside of the loop is the blue city**: hundreds of small blue cube
  houses packed on a slope that rises toward the fort. No park, no lake and
  no open square inside the loop.

**CAMERA AND BASE:** raised 3/4 view **from the front edge**, so the clock
tower is nearest and the fort is at the back-right, high above everything.
The diorama sits on a thin dark rounded-rectangle base with a matte edge.
Behind the base, softly out of focus, low desert hills fade into warm dusty
haze, with the silhouette of a **domed sandstone palace on a distant hill**
on the left.

**STYLE (strict) [!]:** **flat-shaded low-poly, like a game-asset render in a
Blender viewport. Every face is one flat colour.** Big facets. No painted
texture, no photorealism, no tilt-shift look. Houses are simple cubes with
a few cut-out doors and windows, not detailed miniatures. Soft baked ambient
occlusion under every object. Toy proportions: cars are stubby and about
1.3× wider than real cars.

**PALETTE (strict) [!]:**
- **blue houses in TWO tones: light sky-blue `#8FB0DC` and deeper indigo
  `#4F6FB8`**, mixed house by house. NOT turquoise, NOT navy, NOT purple.
  A few houses in pale ochre `#D9B98A` break the blue (about 1 in 8);
- **fort: red-brown sandstone `#A5553A`**, rock under it pink-brown
  `#9A6A5A`;
- **stepwell: rose-peach sandstone `#D4957A`**;
- **cenotaph: warm white marble `#EEE8DF`** (the only big white thing);
- **water: still dark green `#2E4A3C`** (NOT blue);
- streets: stone paving `#8E857A`, asphalt `#4A4745`;
- **black `#23201E` cylindrical water tanks on many rooftops**;
- sky: orange-pink at the horizon `#FFB27A` → violet `#6B5A9E` at the top.

The saturated colours allowed are **only**: the toy cars, the **black-and-
yellow auto-rickshaws**, the **bazaar textiles** (red, pink, yellow, green
strips hanging across the bazaar street only), the **orange marigold
garlands**, the **peacocks**, and the **thousands of tiny warm lights**.

**LIGHT [!]:** the sun is **very low, about 8°, on the RIGHT**, just
setting behind the fort. **The fort is backlit**: dark red with a glowing
orange rim. Long shadows of the houses fall toward the left across the
blue city. **The lamps are just coming on**: tiny warm-orange **oil lamps
(diyas) line every parapet, doorstep and stepwell stair**, strings of warm
bulbs cross the streets, and some windows glow. **No neon, no electric
signs, no blue or white lights.**

**THE ROUTE, in driving order:**
1. **A: start under the clock tower.** A square with a tall sandstone
   **clock tower** (about 5 cars tall) with four clock faces. A big
   colourful **rangoli pattern is painted on the paving of the start grid**.
   A stone arch gateway to the market. Three black-and-yellow
   **auto-rickshaws** are parked at the kerb.
2. **B: the bazaar.** A street lined with market stalls under cloth
   canopies, sacks of red and yellow spices, a fruit handcart, and
   **long strips of coloured cloth hanging across the street** above the
   cars. **Auto-rickshaws drive on the LEFT side of the road**; one toy car
   overtakes on the right, and another has just bumped a rickshaw, which is
   tipping onto two wheels.
3. **C: the stepwell [!], the biggest feature.** A long **rectangular pit
   cut into the ground (about 25 cars long, 10 cars wide, 2 cars deep)**
   with its walls made of **zig-zag flights of steps in inverted-V
   patterns**, three levels deep, rose sandstone, and dark green water at the
   bottom with floating oil lamps. **The road goes DOWN INTO the pit on a
   ramp along one long wall, makes a tight U-turn at its inner end (toward
   the centre of the loop) under a small columned pavilion, and climbs back
   UP along the opposite wall.**
   No railing toward the water. Children sit on the steps above the ramps.
4. **D: the blue city.** The road climbs through tightly packed blue cube
   houses with outside staircases, carved balconies, rooftop terraces and
   black water tanks, toward the fort. Peacocks stand on walls. On the left
   pavement, a **wedding procession**: a white horse with a decorated rider
   and a small group of drummers. **The shortcut [!]:** a **very narrow
   alley**, one car wide, between blue walls with laundry lines, leaves the
   road and rejoins it higher up. **A white humped zebu cow with
   orange-painted horns and a marigold garland lies right in the mouth of
   the alley**, blocking it.
5. **E: the fort gates [!].** The road zig-zags up the rock in **sharp
   right-angle turns**, each followed by a **massive gateway with wooden
   doors studded with iron spikes**, standing open. Tall red sandstone walls
   on one side, a crenellated parapet and the drop to the blue city on the
   other. Grey langur monkeys sit on the parapet. **Do not make the fort
   look like a castle from Europe**: no pointed towers, no slate roofs. It
   has **round bastions, flat tops, domed pavilions (chhatris) and
   carved stone balconies (jharokhas)**.
6. **F: the bastion [!].** On top of the rock, the road runs past the
   palace's carved facade, then **out onto a bastion that juts toward the
   city**: a U-turn on its tip, **with the whole blue city spread below**. A
   row of **old cannons on the ramparts fires a salute toward the city** in
   puffs of white smoke. A **zip-line cable** crosses above the bastion with
   a tiny rider. Black kites (birds) circle **below** the bastion.
7. **G: the descent.** The road comes down the right side over **bare
   pink-brown volcanic rock** with a few column cacti (euphorbia) and dry
   shrubs. On the far right, a **small dark lake** with a **white marble
   cenotaph** (a domed memorial with four small domed kiosks) on a rock
   above it. **The road jumps across an arm of the lake over a rock
   ramp**: one car is in the air over the water.
8. **H: the straight home.** A long straight street back to the clock
   tower, under strings of warm bulbs. Two auto-rickshaws join from a side
   street. **A few fireworks burst LOW over the blue city**, just above the
   rooftops, not high in the sky.

**SCALE [!]:** a toy car is about 4 m long. An auto-rickshaw is about
**two-thirds of a car**. The cow is about **half a car** long. A peacock is
smaller than a car wheel with its tail closed. The blue houses are **2–4
storeys, each storey about as tall as a car is long**. The fort walls are
about **3–4 houses tall** above the rock.

**CARS:** 6–8 chunky toy cars in saturated colours (red, blue, yellow, a
white police car, a big red fire truck, a long yellow bus) spread around
the loop, one drifting in the stepwell U-turn.
Se dă primul, cu planul atașat. Dacă diorama iese cu bucla antiorară, cu fortul în stânga-spate sau cu lacul în stânga, reafirmă corecția din v0.2: bucla e orară, fortul e în spate-dreapta, lacul e în dreapta, iar soarele vine din dreapta.

3 · Prompt pentru planșa de inventar (ChatGPT) · 12 rânduri, cu numele de fișier 

Using the exact same low-poly, flat-shaded, faceted style, palette and
lighting as the diorama above, create an **asset inventory sheet**: a single
tall image on a neutral light-grey background, **12 rows**, each item
isolated in 3/4 view with soft baked ambient occlusion, **lit by neutral
daylight** (not sunset — this sheet is for shapes and base colours), drawn
at a consistent scale within its row, with a small 4 m toy-car silhouette
in the corner of each row, and **its file name written in small monospace
letters under each item**. No text other than the file names. **Where the
diorama disagrees with the following rules, the rules win:** every face is
one flat colour, with big facets and no painted texture. Blue houses use
only `#8FB0DC` and `#4F6FB8`; fort `#A5553A`; rock `#9A6A5A`; stepwell
`#D4957A`; marble `#EEE8DF`; water tanks `#23201E`. **No European castle
shapes, no neon, no text or logos on any vehicle or stall.**
1. **Clock tower and gate** — `ghanta_ghar` (sandstone clock tower, 22 m,
   four clock faces without numbers, a balcony near the top), `market_gate`
   (stone arch gateway, 18 m wide opening).
2. **Stepwell** — `stepwell_flight_module` (a 12 m wide, 3 m tall wall
   section of **inverted-V flights of steps**), `stepwell_corner`,
   `stepwell_pavilion` (two-storey columned gallery, 20 m wide).
3. **Fort walls** — `fort_wall_segment` (12 m long, 14 m tall, crenellated,
   with arrow slits), `fort_bastion` (round tower, flat top, crenellated).
4. **Fort gates** — `fort_gate_jai`, `fort_gate_fateh`, `fort_gate_loha`:
   three gateways with flanking towers and **open wooden doors studded with
   iron spikes**, each with a **7 m wide opening**.
5. **Palace** — `palace_facade_a`, `palace_facade_b`: 20 m wide, three
   storeys of **carved projecting balconies (jharokhas)** and **pierced
   stone screens (jali)**; the lower two storeys richly carved, the top one
   plain.
6. **Cenotaph and cannon** — `jaswant_thada` (white marble cenotaph, 14 m,
   central dome and four small domed kiosks), `rampart_cannon` (old bronze
   cannon on a wooden carriage with spoked wheels).
7. **Blue houses** — `blue_house_a`… `blue_house_e`: cube houses, 2–4
   storeys, arched doors, shuttered windows, one with an outside staircase,
   one with a rooftop terrace; `haveli_facade` (richer house with stone
   balconies); `rooftop_tank` (black cylindrical water tank);
   `rooftop_clutter`.
8. **Bazaar** — `stall_canopy_a`, `stall_canopy_b`, `stall_canopy_c`
   (market stalls under cloth canopies), `textile_strip` (a long strip of
   coloured cloth to hang across a street), `spice_sacks`, `thela_cart`
   (fruit handcart on two bicycle wheels), `chai_stall`,
   `marigold_garland`.
9. **Vehicles** — `tuktuk` (**black-and-yellow three-wheeled
   auto-rickshaw, 2.6 m long, NO logo**), shown from the front-3/4 and the
   back-3/4.
10. **Animals** — `zebu_cow` (white **humped** zebu cow, orange-painted
    horns, marigold garland, a small bell; two poses: standing / lying
    down), `peacock` (two poses: tail closed / tail fanned), `langur`
    (grey monkey with a black face, sitting), `black_kite_bird` (wings
    spread).
11. **Desert rock and trees** — `rhyolite_boulder_a/b/c`, `rock_slab`,
    `euphorbia` (columnar desert cactus), `neem_tree`, `khejri_tree`
    (sparse desert tree).
12. **Procession and zip-line** — `baraat_horse` (white horse with a
    decorated rider), `baraat_band` (a small group of drummers as one
    piece), `zipline_rider` (a small figure hanging from a pulley).
Se dă în aceeași conversație, după dioramă, ca să moștenească stilul. Numele de fișier de pe planșă sunt contractul cu docs/asset_briefs/jodhpur_kit.md (de scris după planșă) și cu categoria assets/models/jodhpur/. Planșa cere doar ce are consumator sau e decor pur: fără stânca fortului, groapa fântânii, kickerul, apa, artificiile și candelele MultiMesh, fără piesele refolosite (bougainvillea, tufa uscată, rufele, scuterul, bicicleta, altarul).
